review: Core of sinking teams, he inflicts a decent amount of sinking while also having both good amount of coins and rolls. His S2 can turn into aoe with enough tremor making him inflict a total of 18 sinking potency. His bread and butter lies within his S3 which causes Sinking Deluge that can potentially send the enemy into a shadow realm with emotional damage if they have high sinking potency and count. Notable E.G.O. Synergy: Sunshower - he can make use of the sloth dmg amp while also having synergy with his passive allowing him to deal more damage with it.
